FY27 Commercial & Community Buildings Grant Program

Main_Content

 

Now Open! FY​27 Commercial & Community Buildings Grant Program


Program Purpose: The intent of the Maryland Energy Administration (“MEA”) Commercial & Community Buildings Grant Program is to facilitate building decarbonization through energy efficiency upgrades, electrification, and renewable energy development and storage for eligible buildings in Maryland. This program aims to accelerate greenhouse gas emissions reductions, lower energy costs, and power robust clean energy and economic development.

Target Audience: State and Montgomery County Building Energy Performance Standards (BEPS) covered buildings, large and small commercial buildings with for-profit and non-profit building owners, county and municipal governments, and Maryland’s Local Education Agencies (LEAs), the Maryland School for the Blind, and the Maryland School for the Deaf.

Program Launch Date: September 9, 2026

Program Application Deadline: December 9, 2026 - 3:00 PM Eastern Time

Type of Program: Statewide Competitive​

Funding Opportunity Announcement: FY27 Commercial & Community Buildings Grant Program v3 (092826)
